_comment: lock-detector smoke bench (issue #54): typical corner, ONE unit (single corner, so `klt sim --backend local` is permitted). Limits are smoke gates derived from spec row 12 (lag <= 128 cycles each way) plus the 64-cycle predicate window, not spec numbers. Simulated, never measured.
Stimulus timeline is in decks/ld_body.spice. Times below are absolute ns of that timeline.
/home/ubuntu/share/pdk/ihp-sg13g2/libs.tech/ngspice/osdi is substituted by run.sh. The corner adds cornerRES (res_typ) for the vmov_cmp rppd low-pass and cornerCAP (cap_typ) for its MIM capacitor.

measurements.name: lock_max_before_220n
measurements.spice: .meas tran lock_max_before_220n max v(lock) from=20n to=220n
